speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling
text: asked the Minister for National Development whether the proportion of units under the Married Child Priority Scheme can be increased for HDB's BTO projects within mature estates to facilitate inter-generational familial support.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: Having said that, we recognise that many children wish to live near their parents for mutual care and support.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: To meet the high demand for flats in mature estates, HDB has launched more flats in mature estates in recent years.

speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling (MacPherson)
text: First, I wonder if the Minister has a figure on the proportion of applicants under MCPS compared to the supply of 30%; that means, how much in excess, in terms of percentage, might there be, on average, for the Build-To-Build (BTO) projects launched?

speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling (MacPherson)
text: With these trends, I certainly hope that MND can continue to consider this, to increase the proportion of units under MCPS.

speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling (MacPherson)
text: Related to this, maybe, could I ask the Minister to share what kind of impact might there be in the composition of the local housing estate in the immediate or the mid- to longer term, if we increase the proportion of units under MCPS?

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: On her request for more allocation under MCPS, I think I have addressed that in my reply.
